name: Ground-Based Fusion Beam
_comment: R1.14, Advanced Missions SSD book page 9. One of the ground base fits — the chassis is the
GBD1's and is identical across all of them: one shield of 12 (P2.73), two hull boxes, a bridge,
sensor 6|0, scanner 0|9, dam-con 4|2|0, five crew, two boarding parties, minCrew 2, DK:4, EX:0,
CR:0. Only the weapons, the power plant, the BPV and the year differ.
Two phaser-Gs rather than four phaser-3s — the Hydran pattern, shared with the
hellbore fit. The sheet says the fusion holding refit of Y168 is NOT available here
(E7.54), which our fusion holding already gates by year and would otherwise grant.
